launches.title: ObsessionDB: a real-time data warehouse built for agents
launches.tagline: Give your agents the data stack they need
launches.body:
Hi YC, we are Marc, Rafael, and Marc - co-founders of ObsessionDB.

**TL;DR:** ObsessionDB is a real-time data warehouse that makes your data stack agent-ready. Your agents can ingest and query vast amounts of data in seconds, without the scary infra bill.

<https://youtu.be/1AFlb772hl4>

**Why now**

Agents are the new heaviest users of your data warehouse. They generate data nonstop, scan it millions of times a day, and provision their own infra. Existing data warehouses and data platforms weren't built for these workloads. We see this as a generational opportunity, and we're building it.

Warehouses and data platforms like Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks are built for batch jobs and get expensive fast at this volume. Operational, transactional databases fall short. Without a scalable, cost-effective solution, teams end up rationing their data instead of building on it.

Companies shouldn't fear their fast-growing data.

**What ObsessionDB does**

ObsessionDB allows data teams to ingest, process, and query all their growing data:

* **Agent data to insights:** messy transcripts, logs, and traces become structured, queryable data as they arrive, fast, in real time
* **Real-time analytics** on huge, fast-moving datasets
* **Real-time customer-facing APIs** served directly on that data, fast enough to power products, not just dashboards
* **Scale without the bill scaling with it:** Built on top of our own compute-storage implementation for ClickHouse t

**In production today**

* **We are processing millions of real-time API requests for our customers,** turning their AI agents' session transcripts into live, queryable data and building real-time APIs on top.
* Our biggest customer moved off Elasticsearch and now serves real-time APIs on **50TB of data**, ingesting **hundreds of thousands of events per minute**.

**Why us: we've already run this at petabyte scale**

At our last company, we built real-time blockchain APIs on **petabytes of data** and hit a wall with every warehouse on the market, both on cost and on speed. So we took the open-source ClickHouse® engine, forked it, and rebuilt it with compute and storage separated: one copy of the data on cheap object storage, with stateless compute on top. ObsessionDB is that system, productized and built for the agent era.

**Our ask**

* **Building with AI agents and sitting on a growing pile of transcripts, traces or logs?** Let us help you extract more value.
* Is Postgres getting too slow for your analytical workloads? Talk to us.
* **Paying too much for Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or ClickHouse Cloud?** We can help you cut it in half; reach out.
* **Intros** to teams drowning in agent-generated or growing data.
